about: Grammatical gender of es-419 item names, for names whose es-419 text changes gender (nevera -> refrigerador).
Keys are "<record>:<row>" of a record with the item-name layout 32:ssssssii (4650, 4164); values are "m" or "f".
The build clears (m) or sets (f) bits 0x00100010 of the row's first attribute word in the es-419 copy only; every other bit is kept.
